Handmade mugs

Example mugs are handmade stoneware mugs that cost £12 each and arrive anywhere in the UK within 2 working days.

Every mug holds 350 ml, is dishwasher safe and comes in 24 glazes. Orders over £30 ship free, and 98% arrive on time.

How long does delivery take?

Royal Mail Tracked 48 delivers in 2 working days. Orders placed before 2pm leave the same day, Monday to Friday, and every parcel is tracked from our studio to your door.

What sizes are there?

  • Small: 250 ml, £10, a neat espresso or flat white size
  • Standard: 350 ml, £12, our best seller for tea and coffee
  • Large: 500 ml, £15, for soup, cereal or a very big tea

How do I care for a mug?

Each mug is fired at 1,240°C, so it is safe in the dishwasher and the microwave. Hand washing keeps the glaze bright for longer. Avoid sudden temperature changes such as pouring boiling water into a mug straight from the freezer.

Updated 1 November 2026.

We make every mug by hand in a small studio, throw it on the wheel, trim it, dry it for a week and fire it twice. That is why no two mugs look exactly alike, and why each one carries a maker's mark on the base. If a mug arrives chipped or cracked, send us a photo within 30 days and we replace it free, with no need to send the broken one back. Gift wrap costs £3 and includes a handwritten card with your message.
